summary: Two Palestinian youths, ages 19 and 16, were killed and one Palestinian was seriously wounded by IDF live fire during a stone-throwing disturbance as Israeli security forces exited al-Mughayyir after a livestock-recovery operation; an earlier settler-Palestinian clash occurred separately in the village.
discovery_sources: Ynet 2026-09-02; Reuters 2026-09-02; WAFA 2026-09-02; Times of Israel 2026-09-02; exact Quds News same-event video
resolution_notes: Freshness correction: Reuters, citing the Palestinian Health Ministry, reports the two victims were ages 16 and 19; WAFA's later same-night roundup identifies Omar Mohammad Na'ssan as 19 and Khalil Abu Aliya as 16. Earlier Ynet/WAFA versions reported both as 19, and one updated WAFA page briefly listed both as 16, so the source-version discrepancy is preserved. Reuters also quotes the IDF saying troops fired on 'key instigators' during a violent disturbance and that the incident is under investigation. Canonical shooter attribution remains IDF/security-force fire; no partisan affiliation is assigned. Canonical Sheet was corrected first, Reuters added as SRC-2026-0202, then Notion corrected and post-write verified.
media_status: MED-2026-0073 exact Quds News same-event video remains the exact media route and does not depict the fatal shots. Reuters article photographs depict a separate Beita incident and were explicitly rejected. Existing GitHub preview remains Blocked; no generic or related imagery substituted.
